construction.implementation_origin: Newly authored isolated Python standard-library reference implementation

shared_schema.input: schema_version, fixture_label, query, question, products[], sources[], optional filters and limit
shared_schema.product: id, name, description, category, nonnegative finite price, uppercase currency, boolean in_stock
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, fixture_label, search {query, interpreted_terms, results[]}, research {question, evidence[], comparison[], recommendation|null, limitations[]}
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function checks request, search boundary, final output, referential integrity, unchanged product snapshots, filters and verbatim citations. CLI validation/file failures are JSON status:error with exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input feeds search. Research validates the search handoff against the original request before consuming selected product IDs and rank.
Research only cites sources linked to selected products. Search limit, price/category/availability constraints propagate to research comparison and recommendations.
One final validated JSON envelope preserves input query, question and fixture label.

behavior.search: Case-insensitive alphanumeric tokenization; stopwords, small generic synonym map and conservative difflib typo matching. Partial matches allowed. Scores normalize matched weights by query terms. Tie break: price then product ID. Explicit filters are hard constraints; limit 1..50.
behavior.research: Question-token overlap retrieves source evidence. Retains complete verbatim source text, IDs, titles and kinds. Compares evidence coverage and recommends a candidate for further evaluation, not purchase, using relevant source count then search rank. Abstains when evidence is absent.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clocks, network, external provider, or LLM. Stable ordering throughout.
behavior.fixture_data: All example products and sources are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.usage: Run both commands from this directory with -B to avoid bytecode files.

cli_example.stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok; selected p1 and p2; only their sources cited; p1 prioritized for further evaluation.
